subject: Business Models
title: Winner's Curse in Auctions
description: One-minute skill: Winner's Curse in Auctions.

hook.text: The company that 'wins' a government contract auction often overpays. The winner's curse is real.

buildup.text: In competitive bidding, the highest bidder likely overestimated value. Winning means you guessed highest.

discovery.text: Google's ad auctions use a 'second price' model. You pay what the second-highest bidder offered, not your bid.

twist.text: Second-price auctions encourage honest bidding. You can bid your true value without fear of overpaying.

climax.text: Auction design is a science. Small rule changes can shift billions in outcomes.

punchline.text: Bid highest, pay too much. The winner's curse haunts every auction.

quiz.question: What is the winner's curse?
options: The highest bidder likely overestimated value
